Cloudflare hosts the API and D1 databases. Complete Draft traces are stored in a private R2 bucket and cannot be accessed from the site; the bucket lifecycle deletes them after 730 days. Attachments from closed tickets are deleted after 90 days and the full closed ticket after 365 days. Account sessions last at most 30 days; OAuth states and one-time linking codes expire after 10 minutes. Account data stays until account deletion. Draft indexes and matches currently have no defined maximum retention period or automatic cleanup: they remain until deletion is requested.
